column1: # ci/extract-dlls.tsv - the files of the FL Studio installer (flstudio_win64_26.1.7.5653.exe) that the engine bundle build reads, besides the seed files of lift/harness/seeds/vfs-seed-idle1.tsv.

# Fields (TAB): name in the installer's NSIS file list (matched as a case-insensitive suffix, like tools/extract_nsis2.py) <TAB> destination under HOST_ROOT <TAB> SHA-256 the extracted bytes must have
# The SHA-256 values are the ones of docs/investigations/win64-extraction.md (FLEngine) and docs/investigations/bundled-dll-inventory.md (the others).
# Note (2026-11-17, decision 0415): ci/lib/extract_fl.py, named in the comments below, was deleted in 9590e599. app/scripts/extract-fl.mjs reads this table now. Those names are records, not calls.
# 2026-11-16 (R6-12): the two Fruity plugin DLLs of gen-direct.sh (decision 0313 G9-c) were not extracted by this table, so the gen stage failed in the workflow.
# Their SHA-256 are those the extractor verified from the installer 26.1.7.5653 (evidence/R6-12.md section 5: extract_fl.py exit 0, "all SHA-256 verified").
# 2026-11-17 (R5-6a, decision 0408): Fruity Delay 2, the tenth module. The SHA-256 is the one extract_fl.py verifies from the installer 26.1.7.5653 (evidence/R5-6a.md section 2).
